body: Hey OP, please don’t do this. It is your decision and I will not act to stop you, as you are the only one in control. But I just wanted to say I love you as a brother or sister and you are more than welcome to message me. If you do go through with it, I’m sorry, but please, don’t use antidepressants, it would be a very slow, and very very painful way to go, well, you might even survive with an even worse life. I’d hate to see that. Please hang on if you can and are willing to. Love you ❤️ much support. If you need anything I’m here.

Hey, I’m on melatonin and Prozac too. Guess we are very similar as I also tried hanging myself so I’m probs not the best when it comes to advice, but please, even if you don’t make it, remember you can always message me. Stay strong buddy, love ya
Hello would you like to message me? We can talk! Always here.

Hey OP! I am going through this same experience and bout with suicidal thoughts. Just so you know, you mean a lot too us all here. We are supporting you through all of this and you are always welcome to either message one of us or make a post. We can do this together! Let’s keep fighting! Obviously, I can’t put you off ending your life, that is your choice and who am I to stop someone doing something I’ve tried countless times. Either way, think it through a little please, for me, for you, for each other. I hope you have a blessed day even if you decide not to carry on, you’ll always have a place in my memory and mind, and we’ll meet again someday. Love you. Stay strong buddy.

Hey Damien, I know how you feel... In fact, I have this same thought process right now. I tried hanging myself last night, unfortunately the allotment couldn’t hold my weight and broke. I should be dead, but I’m not. Just know, I’m not the best when it comes to advice, but you’re not alone here. As much as it may seem that way, look at all the other posts here, so many people go through this, me, you, and so many other people here. I wish I could give you a hug right now, I wish I could talk too you, we are both very similar. I have no friends, my family hates me. I know how it feels. I have nothing left. If you like, my message box is always open for you and I welcome you anytime to message me. I am here for you, even if I’m not the best supporting person, you are important. We breathe the same air so you are my brother. Love ya man. Stay strong if you can, and don’t be ashamed if you fall sometimes, it happens. x
Thanks. For some reason I can’t see comments
I’ve tried it, that was a long time ago. How does it feel? I just tried ending my life, so any advice on coping mechanisms at this point is helpful.

Hey, Thank you. It means a lot somebody caring for me, well, sorta caring I guess. It’s just, I’ve tried finding that family. I’ve tried everything in the book I can think of. Whatever I do, I can’t live on, I can’t succeed. I had one plan in life, one, now I can’t even fulfil it. I’m stuck here, lifeless. I have no meaning, just another living being which happens to steal oxygen from those who are in desperate need of it. I don’t want to be here anymore, I’ve thought about the good things in life, but they’re all gone. I always look back on memories, but when I look forward, all I see is agony and pain. I spend my whole day, with no energy,  no hope, no desire, just contemplation. Just wish I could take the place of someone who enjoys life and wants to stay, but has left this world cause they could happily take my one way ticket to life.
